candidates.tagline: "Robots Never Clock Out" — but two were fired for bad attitude
candidates.story: On November 4, 2026, AgiBot ran a 24-hour 'Robots Never Clock Out' trial with six G2 humanoid robots at a convenience store; four were promoted to official employees, but two were dismissed from their probationary period — one for 'slacking off' and lacking 'on-duty enthusiasm,' and one for being unable to keep up with the pace.
candidates.why_funny: The robots designed to outperform every human worker, marketed under the slogan 'Robots Never Clock Out,' had to be let go from their first job for underperforming and having a bad attitude.
candidates.alt: AgiBot G2 humanoid robots working at a convenience store during the 'Robots Never Clock Out' trial, stocking shelves and performing tasks alongside human staff

candidates.tagline: AI promised the world compute campuses. Voters promised them the door.
candidates.story: On November 3, 2026, American voters rejected AI data centers in 40 of 45 ballot measures across 10 states — the same week OpenAI announced a plan to rename data centers 'compute campuses' to make them more palatable to communities where 71% of Americans already oppose one being built nearby.
candidates.why_funny: The AI industry's response to overwhelming public opposition was to rebrand the facilities, then discover that renaming a giant power-hungry warehouse does not change how people feel about living next to one.
candidates.alt: Drone aerial view of rows of large grey industrial server buildings at the Apple Sparks Campus data center complex in Sparks, Nevada
